# Arrangement Pull Request Instructions

A PR should state:

1. what changed and why;
2. affected architecture owners/layers;
3. security/tenancy/provider consequences when relevant;
4. fresh validation evidence with exact checks;
5. setup/migration/deployment actions that remain;
6. linked Issue/acceptance criteria when the repository uses them.

Do not claim production readiness, migration success, provider readiness, or deployment verification without executed evidence.
